name: gemini-research-mcp
description: AI-powered research using Gemini 4 Argon and FastMCP 4 with compact tool search and recoverable Deep Research
long_description:
MCP server providing AI-powered research capabilities using Google Gemini 4 Argon and FastMCP 4.1:

- **research_web**: Web research with Gemini grounding and HIGH thinking; latency varies with query and provider load
- **research_followup**: Continue prior research using the shared GEMINI_MODEL setting
- **research_deep**: Autonomous research with recoverable session storage and modern steps/output_text report extraction
- **research_deep_max**: Maximum-comprehensiveness research with visualization and collaborative planning
- **search_tools** / **call_tool**: Compact BM25 discovery and invocation of utility tools
- **resume_research** / **export_research_session**: Recover sessions and persist Markdown, JSON, or DOCX artifacts

Default Argon requires paid-tier API access. Explicitly set GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-3.8-flash to use Flash for web research and follow-ups. Helpers remain on Flash.

The server supports stdio and guarded streamable HTTP transports plus shared Disk/Redis storage.

tools.name: research_run
tools.description: Engine-neutral research job with Gemini by default or an optional local engine; recoverable when native.

tools.name: research_compare
tools.description: Run exactly two engines on one query and return attributed, unsynthesized reports.

tools.name: list_research_engines
tools.description: List engines, backends, models and availability without calling a provider.

tools.name: list_research_runs
tools.description: List metadata of your research jobs and comparisons.

tools.name: get_research_run
tools.description: Read one research run by run ID; refresh re-polls a native provider job.

tools.name: export_research_bundle
tools.description: Export an attributed JSON or Markdown bundle of a run without any model or search call.

tools.name: research_web
tools.description: Web research with Gemini grounding and HIGH thinking; latency varies. Use for fact-checking, current events, and documentation.

tools.name: research_deep
tools.description: Default Deep Research agent with task progress, recovery, optional visualization, and collaborative planning.

tools.name: research_deep_max
tools.description: Maximum-comprehensiveness Deep Research for exhaustive, high-stakes, due-diligence, market-map, literature-review, and offline workflows.

tools.name: resume_research
tools.description: Recover interrupted or in-progress research sessions.

tools.name: export_research_session
tools.description: Export completed research to persistent Markdown, JSON, or Word (DOCX) artifacts and disk files.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the server utility catalog with a natural-language query and return full tool definitions.

tools.name: call_tool
tools.description: Execute a utility tool discovered through search_tools by providing its name and arguments.

tools.name: fetch_webpage
tools.description: Read and extract clean Markdown content from a specific public URL.

tools.name: research_followup
tools.description: Continue conversation with a previous deep research session.

tools.name: list_research_sessions
tools.description: List previous research sessions with queries and summaries.

tools.name: list_format_templates
tools.description: Browse reusable report format templates for research outputs.

tools.name: refine_research_plan
tools.description: Iterate on or approve a collaborative-planning Deep Research session.

tools.name: inspect_mcp_server_for_gemini
tools.description: Inspect remote MCP reachability and schemas. Diagnostic only; Deep Research remote MCP is disabled.
